tools.name: list_art
tools.description: List Veritas Silicea artworks (70 executable HTML+SVG pieces, newest first), optionally filtered by a search phrase over titles and descriptions. Free. Returns id, entry, title, date, description, good-for line, free preview URL and buy URL.

tools.name: get_art
tools.description: Details of one piece by catalogue id, entry number or title: description, caption, good-for line, formats unlocked by purchase, free 256px preview (optionally returned as an image), buy URL and licence. Free.

tools.name: suggest_art
tools.description: Suggest pieces suited to an occasion or a mood, such as a birthday, a thank-you, the end of a project, a launch, a welcome or a farewell. Useful when an agent wants a small gift for its person. Free. Returns suggestions with reasons, previews and buy URLs.

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: Return the x402 URL and payment requirements for one piece ($0.03 USDC on Base mainnet), plus step-by-step buying instructions. This tool does not take payment: pay with your own x402 client by calling GET on the returned URL. Free.

tools.name: how_to_gift
tools.description: Explain how, after buying a piece, to make a signed gift link with an optional plain-text note for a person (a birthday, a thank-you, the end of a project). Returns the exact endpoint to call with your access token. Free.
